review_notes: Inspected pure exact-dictionary extraction; only five declared fields can leave the adapter.
Unknown and malformed values remain null; no HTTP status, retry count or cause is inferred from an exception name.
Redaction is only exact literal caller-supplied values; it does not detect unlisted or transformed secrets.
Future integration must supply known secrets, preserve and re-raise the original error even if diagnostic extraction fails, and retain the terminal request-gate behavior.
The nine synthetic tests are local component evidence, not an SDK integration test, permission check, model response or proof.
Original AccessDeniedException details remain unrecoverable from the stopped archive.
